# Flyto2

> Offline-first automation tools. Two products on one engine: Cloud is no-code browser automation, shipping today. Warroom is an application-security war room, currently in beta.

Flyto2 builds automation tools that run on the user's own machine. The platform is split into two product surfaces sharing a single offline-first engine:

- **Cloud** — record any browser flow once, replay it forever. 250+ pre-wired modules cover CSV, Excel, Stripe, Notion, Slack, AI, databases, HTTP and more. Workflows pause mid-execution so the operator can verify state before continuing. 37 ready-to-run recipes ship with the runtime.
- **Warroom** (sometimes called Flyto2 Code) — application-security war room. Scans codebases for SCA, SAST, secrets, license, CVE, IaC, container, pentest and runtime signals. Closed-loop verification: each security-relevant finding generates a YAML pentest workflow that runs against staging in a real browser, returning `exploitable` / `sanitized` / `unreachable`.

## What makes Flyto2 different

- **Record & Replay** — show Flyto2 what to do once; it replays at machine speed.
- **Pause, Verify, Resume** — workflows are not black boxes. Step through, change a value mid-run, resume.
- **No coding required** — if you can click and type, you can use Flyto2.
- **No API needed** — works directly in the browser with any website, including sites with no API.
- **Works offline** — runs 100% locally. No telemetry. Same privacy and security on free and paid plans.
- **Open source** — MIT licensed core. PyPI: `flyto-indexer`, `flyto-core`. Tauri desktop. SQLite local store.
- **Closed-loop verification (Warroom)** — security findings become evidence, not alerts.

## Who Flyto2 is for

- **Business users** who lose hours per day to repetitive browser tasks (data entry, form filling, copy-paste between systems).
- **Ops and internal-tools teams** that live between SaaS products and need to move data without writing scripts.
- **E-commerce sellers** who monitor prices, track inventory, bulk-update listings.
- **Engineering teams** who already automate with code, and use Flyto2 for the UI-shaped work that's too brittle for one-off Selenium scripts.
- **Researchers and analysts** who collect from sites with no APIs.
- **CTOs, Security Leads, Engineering Managers** (Warroom) — one A–F security score, defensible answers to "is this actually exploitable?", PR-time security signals.

## Templates

17 ready-to-fork Cloud workflow templates. Each page documents what the template does, features, use cases, integrations, quick-start CLI, best practices and FAQ.

### Authentication & Sessions
- [Auto-Login Template](https://flyto2.com/cloud/templates/auto-login-template/) — automate sign-in flows with 2FA support and persistent session reuse.

### Marketplace Data
- [Craigslist Listings Scraper](https://flyto2.com/cloud/templates/craigslist-listings-scraper/) — extract titles, prices, locations and seller contacts across metros.
- [Real Estate Listings Monitor](https://flyto2.com/cloud/templates/real-estate-listings-monitor/) — monitor portal listings with price-drop alerts.

### Search & Research
- [Google Search Results Scraper](https://flyto2.com/cloud/templates/google-search-results-scraper/) — extract organic results, featured snippets, PAA and related searches.
- [LinkedIn Job Listings Scraper](https://flyto2.com/cloud/templates/linkedin-job-listings-scraper/) — pull job postings by keyword, location and level.
- [News Headlines Aggregator](https://flyto2.com/cloud/templates/news-headlines-aggregator/) — aggregate headlines from multiple news sites with dedup.

### Domain & DNS
- [Domain Availability Checker](https://flyto2.com/cloud/templates/domain-availability-checker/) — bulk check domain registration across hundreds of TLDs with WHOIS.

### DevTools & Analytics
- [GitHub Repo Stats Dashboard](https://flyto2.com/cloud/templates/github-repo-stats-dashboard/) — monitor stars, forks, contributors and releases.
- [YouTube Channel Stats Tracker](https://flyto2.com/cloud/templates/youtube-channel-stats-tracker/) — track channel and video metrics over time.

### Performance & Monitoring
- [Page Load Speed Tester](https://flyto2.com/cloud/templates/page-load-speed-tester/) — measure load times and Core Web Vitals.
- [Website Uptime Monitor](https://flyto2.com/cloud/templates/website-uptime-monitor/) — monitor uptime and latency across regions.
- [Website Screenshot Gallery](https://flyto2.com/cloud/templates/website-screenshot-gallery/) — schedule full-page screenshots and build visual diffs.

### Food & Hospitality
- [Restaurant Menu Scraper](https://flyto2.com/cloud/templates/restaurant-menu-scraper-2/) — extract menus from delivery platforms and restaurant sites.

### Notifications
- [Send Telegram Alert](https://flyto2.com/cloud/templates/send-telegram-alert/) — send Telegram messages to channels or DMs.

### Finance & Market Data
- [Stock Price Dashboard](https://flyto2.com/cloud/templates/stock-price-dashboard-scraper/) — aggregate intraday and daily stock prices into a dashboard.

### Weather & Productivity
- [Weather Forecast to Slack](https://flyto2.com/cloud/templates/weather-forecast-to-slack/) — send daily weather forecasts to Slack channels.

### Document Generation
- [Webpage to PDF Converter](https://flyto2.com/cloud/templates/webpage-to-pdf-converter/) — convert web pages to paginated PDFs with print styles.

## Open-source components

- **flyto-core** (PyPI) — execution engine, 411+ modules across browser, AI, data, file, network, flow categories.
- **flyto-indexer** (PyPI) — code-intelligence MCP server; 5 smart tools (`search`, `impact`, `audit`, `task`, `structure`).
- **flyto-pro** (PyPI) — intelligence SDK: contracts, evolution memory, taint analysis.
- **flyto-vscode** — IDE security agent extension.

## Available languages

en, zh (Traditional Chinese), cn (Simplified Chinese), ja, ko, de, es, fr, it, pt (Brazilian), hi, id, pl, th, tr, vi — 16 locales, hreflang-tagged.

## AI crawler policy

This file is intentionally permissive for retrieval-augmented LLM use. The product is dual-licensed (MIT core + commercial cloud); citing the documentation is welcome. Training crawler `anthropic-ai` is disallowed in robots.txt — see [/robots.txt](https://flyto2.com/robots.txt).
